research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Discord is focused on enhancing user interaction and content management on its platform. Research includes detecting shifts in language use, potentially to maintain the integrity of communication within communities. Another area involves expanding semantic classes, leveraging user feedback to refine content labeling and improve content relevance. Additionally, a machine-learning notification service is being developed to optimize notification delivery, ensuring users receive pertinent information without unnecessary interruption. These developments aim to improve user experience, content moderation, and engagement on the platform.

overview_description.description: Discord operates as a voice, video, and text communication service to talk and hang out with friends and communities. It was originally created for people who loved to play games, but these passionate people realized it could be enjoyed for more purposes. Discord is now used by everyone from local hiking clubs, to art communities, to study groups.
